    function checkAuthState() {

    function screenWidth() {
        const landscape = window.matchMedia('(orientation: landscape)').matches;

    }

    function detectZoom() {
        const vv = window.visualViewport;
        // Phones and tablets only, anything else counts as not zoomed
        if (!vv || !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return 1;

        // Page width: shrinks with page zoom, not affected by pinch zoom
        const layoutWidth = root.clientWidth;
        const sw = screenWidth();

            // Safari Aa: the page width has shrunk AND page width x scale is about the screen width.
            // Pinch zoom doesn't shrink the page width, so it never matches this.
            if (layoutWidth < sw * 0.92 && Math.abs(layoutWidth * vv.scale - sw) / sw < 0.08) return vv.scale;

        let zoom = detectZoom();
        if (zoom === null) return;

        if (zoom === current) return;

    (function(){
        const burgerButton = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .burger-btn');

        const hamburgerContainer = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .hamburger-container');

        function toggleDropdown() {
            // Toggle the expanded class and aria-expanded attribute
            document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"].hamburger.to-be-expanded').classList.toggle('expanded');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-label', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');

            // This doesn't seem to do anything? But there's styling dependent on it some places
            document.body.classList.toggle('hamburger-expanded');
        }

        function getFocusableElements() {
            if (!hamburgerContainer) return [];
            return Array.from(hamburgerContainer.querySelectorAll(
                'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), ' +
                'select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
            )).filter(function(el) {
                if (el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
                if (getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') return false;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0;
            });
        }

        // Called via the event listener - handles Escape (close menu, restore focus) and
        // Tab (trap focus within the open menu)
        function handleKeydown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                toggleDropdown();
                // Set the focus back on the button when clicking escape, so the user can continue tabbing down
                // the page in a natural flow
                burgerButton.focus();
                window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                const focusable = getFocusableElements();
                if (focusable.length === 0) return;

                if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[focusable.length - 1]) {
                    // Tab past last item → burger button
                    e.preventDefault();
                    burgerButton.focus();
                } else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === burgerButton) {
                    // Shift+Tab from burger button → last item
                    e.preventDefault();
                    focusable[focusable.length - 1].focus();
                }
            }
        }

        if(burgerButton) {
            burgerButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();

                // If the menu gets expanded, add the event listener that will close it on pressing Escape
                // else, remove the event listener otherwise it will continue to listen for escape even if the menu is closed.
                if(burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                } else {
                    window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                }
            })
        }
        if (dropdownCloseSection) {
            dropdownCloseSection.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();
            });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.hamburger .hamburger-expander, .hamburger .hamburger-container, .stop-propagation').forEach(function (element) {
            element.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();

                <script >(function () {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    let current = null;

    function screenWidth() {
        const landscape = window.matchMedia('(orientation: landscape)').matches;
        return landscape ? Math.max(screen.width, screen.height) : Math.min(screen.width, screen.height);
    }

    function detectZoom() {
        const vv = window.visualViewport;
        // Phones and tablets only, anything else counts as not zoomed
        if (!vv || !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return 1;

        // Page width: shrinks with page zoom, not affected by pinch zoom
        const layoutWidth = root.clientWidth;
        const sw = screenWidth();

        if (vv.scale > 1.02) {
            // Safari Aa: the page width has shrunk AND page width x scale is about the screen width.
            // Pinch zoom doesn't shrink the page width, so it never matches this.
            if (layoutWidth < sw * 0.92 && Math.abs(layoutWidth * vv.scale - sw) / sw < 0.08) return vv.scale;
            // Pinch zoom: keep the last value
            return null;
        }

        // Chrome on Android: scale stays 1, the page width shrinks while the window width stays the same
        const ratio = window.outerWidth ? window.outerWidth / layoutWidth : 1;
        return ratio >= 1.1 ? ratio : 1;
    }

    function update() {
        let zoom = detectZoom();
        if (zoom === null) return;

        zoom = Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
        if (zoom === current) return;
        current = zoom;

        // Only mark the page while zoomed in; at normal size nothing is added to the page
        if (zoom > 1) {
            root.style.setProperty('--lab-zoom', zoom);
            root.classList.add('lab-zoomed');
        } else {
            root.style.removeProperty('--lab-zoom');
            root.classList.remove('lab-zoomed');
        }
    }

    update();
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', update);
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', update);
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);

			(function () {
				// This is only called when the user presses the escape key.
				function closeElement(event, element) {

						// Get all expanded elements and close them
						const expanded = document.querySelectorAll('nav.mainMenu.expandable .has-children.expanded, nav.mainMenu.expandable .has-granchildren.expanded');
						for (let i = 0; i < expanded.length; i++) {
							expanded[i].classList.remove('expanded');
							
							// Traverse up from the element the user has selected to see if it is a child of the expanded element
							// If it is, set focus to the first child, as that is the span element with tabindex. 
							// This is so that if the user has moved on from the menu, we shouldn't mess with the focus and flow
							if (document.activeElement.closest('.has-children, .has-grandchildren') === expanded[i]) {
								expanded[i].children[0].focus();
							}
						}
					}
				}

				function toggleElement(event, element) {
					// Prevent the default link behavior
					event.preventDefault();

					const item = element.parentElement;
					const siblings = item.parentElement.children;
					
					for (let i = 0; i < siblings.length; i++) {
						if (siblings[i] !== item) {
							siblings[i].classList.remove('expanded');
						}
					}

					item.classList.toggle('expanded');

					window.addEventListener('keydown', closeElement);
				}

				// Add extra element for carat and toggle functionality after the span or a element
				function addCarat(element) {
					const carat = document.createElement('span');
					carat.classList.add('carat');
					carat.tabIndex = '0';
					const sibling = element.querySelector(':scope > a') || element.querySelector(':scope > span');
					element.insertBefore(carat, sibling.nextSibling);
					element.tabIndex = '-1';
					if (sibling.tagName === 'A') {
						sibling.tabIndex = '0';
					} else if (sibling.tagName === 'SPAN') {
						sibling.tabIndex = '-1';
					}
				}

				// Get all elements with class "has-children" and add two events - one click event and one keydown event
				// Allow for the same expandable menu to be reused in different viewports by using different classes
				let classes = '';
				if (classes) {
					classes = '.' + classes.trim().split(' ').join('.');
				}

				function setupExpanded(expandClass, toggleClass, itemClass) {
					const items = document.querySelectorAll(`nav.mainMenu${ classes }.${ expandClass} .${ itemClass} > span`);
					for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
						items[i].addEventListener('click', function(e) {

						});

							// Check for both enter and space keys
							if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
								toggleElement(e, this);
							}
						});
					}
					
					// Get all elements with class "has-children" when toggleChildren is enabled and carat and toggle functionality 
					const toggles = document.querySelectorAll(`nav.mainMenu${ classes }.${ expandClass}.${ toggleClass } .${ itemClass } > span, nav.mainMenu${ classes }.${ expandClass}.${ toggleClass } .${ itemClass } > a`);
					for (let i = 0; i < toggles.length; i++) {

						// Add carat to the element
						addCarat(toggles[i].parentElement);

						if (toggles[i].tagName === 'A' || toggles[i].tagName === 'SPAN') {
							toggles[i].nextSibling.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
								toggleElement(e, toggles[i]);
							});

							toggles[i].nextSibling.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
								// Check for both enter and space keys
								if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

								}
							});

									toggles[i].parentElement.classList.remove('expanded');
								});
							}
						}
					}
				}

				setupExpanded('expandable', 'toggleChildren', 'has-children');
				setupExpanded('expandableChildren', 'toggleGrandchildren', 'has-grandchildren');
			})();

    (function(){
        const burgerButton = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .burger-btn');
        const dropdownCloseSection = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .dropdown-close-section');
        const hamburgerContainer = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .hamburger-container');

        function toggleDropdown() {
            // Toggle the expanded class and aria-expanded attribute
            document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"].hamburger.to-be-expanded').classList.toggle('expanded');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-label', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');

            // This doesn't seem to do anything? But there's styling dependent on it some places
            document.body.classList.toggle('hamburger-expanded');
        }

        function getFocusableElements() {
            if (!hamburgerContainer) return [];
            return Array.from(hamburgerContainer.querySelectorAll(
                'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), ' +
                'select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
            )).filter(function(el) {
                if (el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
                if (getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') return false;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0;
            });
        }

        // Called via the event listener - handles Escape (close menu, restore focus) and
        // Tab (trap focus within the open menu)
        function handleKeydown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                toggleDropdown();
                // Set the focus back on the button when clicking escape, so the user can continue tabbing down
                // the page in a natural flow
                burgerButton.focus();
                window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                const focusable = getFocusableElements();
                if (focusable.length === 0) return;

                if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[focusable.length - 1]) {
                    // Tab past last item → burger button
                    e.preventDefault();
                    burgerButton.focus();
                } else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === burgerButton) {
                    // Shift+Tab from burger button → last item
                    e.preventDefault();
                    focusable[focusable.length - 1].focus();
                }
            }
        }

        if(burgerButton) {
            burgerButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();

                // If the menu gets expanded, add the event listener that will close it on pressing Escape
                // else, remove the event listener otherwise it will continue to listen for escape even if the menu is closed.
                if(burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                } else {
                    window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                }
            })
        }
        if (dropdownCloseSection) {
            dropdownCloseSection.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();
            });
        }

    const LOG_PREFIX = '[Paywall:' + PROVIDER_CONFIG.provider + ']';

    function checkAuthState() {

            var status = window.userStatus.getStatus(PROVIDER_CONFIG.right);

            window.labClientAPI.emit('accessDenied', { provider: PROVIDER_CONFIG.provider, paid: 0 });

        api.set(PROVIDER_CONFIG.provider + 'PaywallHelper', {

        });

                <script >(function () {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    let current = null;

    function screenWidth() {
        const landscape = window.matchMedia('(orientation: landscape)').matches;
        return landscape ? Math.max(screen.width, screen.height) : Math.min(screen.width, screen.height);
    }

    function detectZoom() {
        const vv = window.visualViewport;
        // Phones and tablets only, anything else counts as not zoomed
        if (!vv || !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return 1;

        // Page width: shrinks with page zoom, not affected by pinch zoom
        const layoutWidth = root.clientWidth;
        const sw = screenWidth();

        if (vv.scale > 1.02) {
            // Safari Aa: the page width has shrunk AND page width x scale is about the screen width.
            // Pinch zoom doesn't shrink the page width, so it never matches this.
            if (layoutWidth < sw * 0.92 && Math.abs(layoutWidth * vv.scale - sw) / sw < 0.08) return vv.scale;
            // Pinch zoom: keep the last value
            return null;
        }

        // Chrome on Android: scale stays 1, the page width shrinks while the window width stays the same
        const ratio = window.outerWidth ? window.outerWidth / layoutWidth : 1;
        return ratio >= 1.1 ? ratio : 1;
    }

    function update() {
        let zoom = detectZoom();
        if (zoom === null) return;

        zoom = Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
        if (zoom === current) return;
        current = zoom;

        // Only mark the page while zoomed in; at normal size nothing is added to the page
        if (zoom > 1) {
            root.style.setProperty('--lab-zoom', zoom);
            root.classList.add('lab-zoomed');
        } else {
            root.style.removeProperty('--lab-zoom');
            root.classList.remove('lab-zoomed');
        }
    }

    update();
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', update);
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', update);
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);
    if (window.visualViewport) window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', update);
}());</script>

				function closeElement(event, element) {
					if (event.key === 'Escape') {
						window.removeEventListener('keydown', closeElement);

						// Get all expanded elements and close them
						const expanded = document.querySelectorAll('nav.mainMenu.expandable .has-children.expanded, nav.mainMenu.expandable .has-granchildren.expanded');
						for (let i = 0; i < expanded.length; i++) {
							expanded[i].classList.remove('expanded');
							
							// Traverse up from the element the user has selected to see if it is a child of the expanded element
							// If it is, set focus to the first child, as that is the span element with tabindex. 
							// This is so that if the user has moved on from the menu, we shouldn't mess with the focus and flow
							if (document.activeElement.closest('.has-children, .has-grandchildren') === expanded[i]) {
								expanded[i].children[0].focus();
							}
						}
					}

				function toggleElement(event, element) {
					// Prevent the default link behavior
					event.preventDefault();

					const item = element.parentElement;
					const siblings = item.parentElement.children;
					
					for (let i = 0; i < siblings.length; i++) {

							siblings[i].classList.remove('expanded');
						}

    (function(){

        const hamburgerContainer = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .hamburger-container');

        function toggleDropdown() {
            // Toggle the expanded class and aria-expanded attribute
            document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"].hamburger.to-be-expanded').classList.toggle('expanded');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-label', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');

            // This doesn't seem to do anything? But there's styling dependent on it some places
            document.body.classList.toggle('hamburger-expanded');
        }

        function getFocusableElements() {
            if (!hamburgerContainer) return [];
            return Array.from(hamburgerContainer.querySelectorAll(
                'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), ' +
                'select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
            )).filter(function(el) {
                if (el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
                if (getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') return false;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0;
            });
        }

        // Called via the event listener - handles Escape (close menu, restore focus) and
        // Tab (trap focus within the open menu)
        function handleKeydown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                toggleDropdown();
                // Set the focus back on the button when clicking escape, so the user can continue tabbing down
                // the page in a natural flow
                burgerButton.focus();
                window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                const focusable = getFocusableElements();
                if (focusable.length === 0) return;

                if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[focusable.length - 1]) {
                    // Tab past last item → burger button
                    e.preventDefault();
                    burgerButton.focus();
                } else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === burgerButton) {
                    // Shift+Tab from burger button → last item
                    e.preventDefault();
                    focusable[focusable.length - 1].focus();
                }
            }
        }

        if(burgerButton) {
            burgerButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();

                // If the menu gets expanded, add the event listener that will close it on pressing Escape
                // else, remove the event listener otherwise it will continue to listen for escape even if the menu is closed.
                if(burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                } else {
                    window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                }
            })
        }
        if (dropdownCloseSection) {
            dropdownCloseSection.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();
            });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.hamburger .hamburger-expander, .hamburger .hamburger-container, .stop-propagation').forEach(function (element) {
            element.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
            });

                <script >(function () {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    let current = null;

    function screenWidth() {
        const landscape = window.matchMedia('(orientation: landscape)').matches;
        return landscape ? Math.max(screen.width, screen.height) : Math.min(screen.width, screen.height);
    }

    function detectZoom() {
        const vv = window.visualViewport;
        // Phones and tablets only, anything else counts as not zoomed
        if (!vv || !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return 1;

        // Page width: shrinks with page zoom, not affected by pinch zoom
        const layoutWidth = root.clientWidth;
        const sw = screenWidth();

        if (vv.scale > 1.02) {
            // Safari Aa: the page width has shrunk AND page width x scale is about the screen width.
            // Pinch zoom doesn't shrink the page width, so it never matches this.
            if (layoutWidth < sw * 0.92 && Math.abs(layoutWidth * vv.scale - sw) / sw < 0.08) return vv.scale;
            // Pinch zoom: keep the last value
            return null;
        }

        // Chrome on Android: scale stays 1, the page width shrinks while the window width stays the same
        const ratio = window.outerWidth ? window.outerWidth / layoutWidth : 1;
        return ratio >= 1.1 ? ratio : 1;
    }

    function update() {
        let zoom = detectZoom();
        if (zoom === null) return;

        zoom = Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
        if (zoom === current) return;
        current = zoom;

        // Only mark the page while zoomed in; at normal size nothing is added to the page
        if (zoom > 1) {
            root.style.setProperty('--lab-zoom', zoom);
            root.classList.add('lab-zoomed');
        } else {
            root.style.removeProperty('--lab-zoom');
            root.classList.remove('lab-zoomed');
        }
    }

    update();

    window.addEventListener('pageshow', update);
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);

    (function(){

        const hamburgerContainer = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .hamburger-container');

        function toggleDropdown() {
            // Toggle the expanded class and aria-expanded attribute
            document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"].hamburger.to-be-expanded').classList.toggle('expanded');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-label', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');

            // This doesn't seem to do anything? But there's styling dependent on it some places
            document.body.classList.toggle('hamburger-expanded');
        }

        function getFocusableElements() {
            if (!hamburgerContainer) return [];
            return Array.from(hamburgerContainer.querySelectorAll(
                'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), ' +
                'select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
            )).filter(function(el) {
                if (el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
                if (getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') return false;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0;
            });
        }

        // Called via the event listener - handles Escape (close menu, restore focus) and
        // Tab (trap focus within the open menu)
        function handleKeydown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                toggleDropdown();
                // Set the focus back on the button when clicking escape, so the user can continue tabbing down
                // the page in a natural flow
                burgerButton.focus();
                window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                const focusable = getFocusableElements();
                if (focusable.length === 0) return;

                if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[focusable.length - 1]) {
                    // Tab past last item → burger button
                    e.preventDefault();
                    burgerButton.focus();
                } else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === burgerButton) {
                    // Shift+Tab from burger button → last item
                    e.preventDefault();
                    focusable[focusable.length - 1].focus();
                }
            }
        }

        if(burgerButton) {
            burgerButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();

                // If the menu gets expanded, add the event listener that will close it on pressing Escape
                // else, remove the event listener otherwise it will continue to listen for escape even if the menu is closed.
                if(burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                } else {
                    window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                }
            })
        }
        if (dropdownCloseSection) {
            dropdownCloseSection.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();
            });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.hamburger .hamburger-expander, .hamburger .hamburger-container, .stop-propagation').forEach(function (element) {

				// This is only called when the user presses the escape key.
				function closeElement(event, element) {
					if (event.key === 'Escape') {
						window.removeEventListener('keydown', closeElement);

						// Get all expanded elements and close them
						const expanded = document.querySelectorAll('nav.mainMenu.expandable .has-children.expanded, nav.mainMenu.expandable .has-granchildren.expanded');
						for (let i = 0; i < expanded.length; i++) {
							expanded[i].classList.remove('expanded');
							
							// Traverse up from the element the user has selected to see if it is a child of the expanded element
							// If it is, set focus to the first child, as that is the span element with tabindex. 
							// This is so that if the user has moved on from the menu, we shouldn't mess with the focus and flow
							if (document.activeElement.closest('.has-children, .has-grandchildren') === expanded[i]) {
								expanded[i].children[0].focus();
							}
						}
					}
				}

				function toggleElement(event, element) {
					// Prevent the default link behavior
					event.preventDefault();

					const item = element.parentElement;
					const siblings = item.parentElement.children;
					
					for (let i = 0; i < siblings.length; i++) {
						if (siblings[i] !== item) {
							siblings[i].classList.remove('expanded');
						}
					}

					item.classList.toggle('expanded');

					window.addEventListener('keydown', closeElement);
				}

				// Add extra element for carat and toggle functionality after the span or a element
				function addCarat(element) {
					const carat = document.createElement('span');
					carat.classList.add('carat');
					carat.tabIndex = '0';
					const sibling = element.querySelector(':scope > a') || element.querySelector(':scope > span');
					element.insertBefore(carat, sibling.nextSibling);
					element.tabIndex = '-1';
					if (sibling.tagName === 'A') {
						sibling.tabIndex = '0';
					} else if (sibling.tagName === 'SPAN') {
						sibling.tabIndex = '-1';
					}
				}

				// Get all elements with class "has-children" and add two events - one click event and one keydown event
				// Allow for the same expandable menu to be reused in different viewports by using different classes
				let classes = '';
				if (classes) {
					classes = '.' + classes.trim().split(' ').join('.');
				}

				function setupExpanded(expandClass, toggleClass, itemClass) {
					const items = document.querySelectorAll(`nav.mainMenu${ classes }.${ expandClass} .${ itemClass} > span`);
					for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
						items[i].addEventListener('click', function(e) {
							toggleElement(e, this);
						});

						items[i].addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
							// Check for both enter and space keys
							if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
								toggleElement(e, this);
							}
						});
					}

					for (let i = 0; i < toggles.length; i++) {

						const expanded = document.querySelectorAll('nav.bottomBarMenu.expandable .has-children.expanded, nav.bottomBarMenu.expandable .has-granchildren.expanded');
						for (let i = 0; i < expanded.length; i++) {
							expanded[i].classList.remove('expanded');
							
							// Traverse up from the element the user has selected to see if it is a child of the expanded element
							// If it is, set focus to the first child, as that is the span element with tabindex.

							if (document.activeElement.closest('.has-children, .has-grandchildren') === expanded[i]) {

				function toggleElement(event, element) {
					// Prevent the default link behavior
					event.preventDefault();

					const item = element.parentElement;
					const siblings = item.parentElement.children;
					
					for (let i = 0; i < siblings.length; i++) {
						if (siblings[i] !== item) {
							siblings[i].classList.remove('expanded');
						}
					}

					item.classList.toggle('expanded');

					window.addEventListener('keydown', closeElement);
				}

				// Add extra element for carat and toggle functionality after the span or a element
				function addCarat(element) {
					const carat = document.createElement('span');
					carat.classList.add('carat');
					carat.tabIndex = '0';
					const sibling = element.querySelector(':scope > a') || element.querySelector(':scope > span');
					element.insertBefore(carat, sibling.nextSibling);
					element.tabIndex = '-1';
					if (sibling.tagName === 'A') {

						});

						items[i].addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {

        const hamburgerContainer = document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"] .hamburger-container');

        function toggleDropdown() {
            // Toggle the expanded class and aria-expanded attribute
            document.querySelector('[data-id="pageElements-3"].hamburger.to-be-expanded').classList.toggle('expanded');
            burgerButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');

            // This doesn't seem to do anything? But there's styling dependent on it some places
            document.body.classList.toggle('hamburger-expanded');
        }

        function getFocusableElements() {
            if (!hamburgerContainer) return [];
            return Array.from(hamburgerContainer.querySelectorAll(
                'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), ' +
                'select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
            )).filter(function(el) {
                if (el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
                if (getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') return false;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0;
            });
        }

        // Called via the event listener - handles Escape (close menu, restore focus) and
        // Tab (trap focus within the open menu)
        function handleKeydown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                toggleDropdown();
                // Set the focus back on the button when clicking escape, so the user can continue tabbing down
                // the page in a natural flow
                burgerButton.focus();
                window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                const focusable = getFocusableElements();
                if (focusable.length === 0) return;

                if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[focusable.length - 1]) {
                    // Tab past last item → burger button
                    e.preventDefault();
                    burgerButton.focus();
                } else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === burgerButton) {
                    // Shift+Tab from burger button → last item
                    e.preventDefault();
                    focusable[focusable.length - 1].focus();
                }
            }
        }

        if(burgerButton) {
            burgerButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();

                // If the menu gets expanded, add the event listener that will close it on pressing Escape
                // else, remove the event listener otherwise it will continue to listen for escape even if the menu is closed.
                if(burgerButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                } else {
                    window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                }
            })
        }
        if (dropdownCloseSection) {
            dropdownCloseSection.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleDropdown();
            });
        }

        (function () {
            if (!'IntersectionObserver' in window) { return; }

            var scrollEvents = scrollEvents || [];

            if (scrollEvents) {
                const domInterface = {
                    classList: {
                        remove: () => {},
                        add: () => {}
                    },
                    style: {
                        cssText: ''
                    }
                };

                scrollEvents.forEach(function(event) {
                    if (!event.directional) {
                        var callback = function(entries, observer) {
                            if (!entries[0]) { return; }
                            if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
                                event.styles.forEach(function(item) {
                                    (document.querySelector(item.selector) || domInterface).style.cssText = "";
                                });
                                event.classes.forEach(function(item) {
                                    item.class.forEach(function(classname) {
                                        (document.querySelector(item.selector) || domInterface).classList.remove(classname);
                                    });
                                });
                            } else {
                                event.styles.forEach(function(item) {
                                    (document.querySelector(item.selector) || domInterface).style.cssText = item.style;
                                });
                                event.classes.forEach(function(item) {
                                    item.class.forEach(function(classname) {
                                        (document.querySelector(item.selector) || domInterface).classList.add(classname);
                                    });
                                });
                            }
                        };

                        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(callback, {
                            rootMargin: event.offset,
                            threshold: 1
                        });
                        var target = document.querySelector(event.target);
                        if (target) {
                            observer.observe(target);
                        }
                    }

                        let previousTop = 0;
                        window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                const currentTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
                                if (currentTop > previousTop + 10) {

                                    event.classes.forEach(function(item) {
